title: ACH Processing | NACHA-Aligned Collection & Disbursement | Veteran Loan Servicing
description: Veteran Loan Servicing's ACH payment processing is an active capability: borrower collection and lender disbursement structured around NACHA operating guidelines, with a full audit trail.
lede: ACH payment processing is an active, current operational capability. This page is the single, consistent description of how it works.

sections.heading: Process
paragraphs: Veteran Loan Servicing collects borrower payments via ACH (Automated Clearing House) and disburses to lenders on a scheduled monthly cycle. Collection and disbursement are structured around NACHA operating guidelines, and every transaction is recorded in a reconcilable audit trail. ACH payment processing is an active, current operational capability.
bullets: Collection — borrower payments collected via ACH on the scheduled cycle
Reconciliation — each transaction recorded in a reconcilable audit trail
Disbursement — funds disbursed to lenders on a scheduled monthly cycle
Reporting — disbursement activity appears in lender portfolio reporting

sections.heading: Controls
paragraphs: ACH activity is structured around NACHA operating guidelines. Each transaction carries an audit-trail entry, and collection is reconciled against the loan ledger before disbursement.

sections.heading: Reporting
paragraphs: Every ACH transaction is reconcilable and retained, supporting lender reporting and examiner or LP review.

sections.heading: Benefits
paragraphs: A single, consistent ACH workflow — the same description everywhere on this site and in our chatbot — means lenders and borrowers get one straight answer about how money moves.

faqs.a: Yes. ACH payment collection and lender disbursement are active, current operational capabilities.

faqs.q: How are borrower payments collected and disbursed to lenders?
faqs.a: Borrower payments are collected via ACH and disbursed to lenders on a scheduled monthly cycle, structured around NACHA operating guidelines, with a full audit trail maintained for every transaction.

faqs.q: Is Veteran Loan Servicing NACHA certified?
faqs.a: Veteran Loan Servicing structures its ACH payment processing around NACHA operating guidelines. NACHA does not certify individual companies; it publishes the operating rules that govern ACH transactions in the United States.
